corpus_title: APIstic Real-World OpenAPI Evolution Benchmark Slices
provenance: Mined from APIstic GitHub-sourced OpenAPI repositories (Zenodo 20525072 / ACM MSR 2024)

evolution_pairs.structural_diff: Parameter 'idempotency_key' shifted from header optional to header required
evolution_pairs.description_before: Creates a new charge object. Caller may optionally provide an Idempotency-Key header to prevent duplicate charges.
evolution_pairs.description_after: Creates a new charge object. Mandatory: caller must supply a unique Idempotency-Key header on all charge requests to guarantee idempotency.
evolution_pairs.nlp_detected_shift: Deontic shift: PERMISSION ('may optionally') -> OBLIGATION ('mandatory: must supply')

evolution_pairs.structural_diff: Parameter 'per_page' default value modified from 100 to 30
evolution_pairs.description_before: Returns all commit entries from the repository default branch without restriction.
evolution_pairs.description_after: Returns recent verified commits only. Unverified commits or archived ref heads are omitted from results.
evolution_pairs.nlp_detected_shift: Semantic drift: Universal set ('all commit entries') -> Conditional subset ('verified commits only')

evolution_pairs.structural_diff: Response status changed from 200 OK (Sync) to 202 Accepted (Async Job)
evolution_pairs.description_before: Deletes the specified Pod immediately and purges container resources from cluster node synchronously.
evolution_pairs.description_after: Enqueues Pod deletion into asynchronous cluster garbage collector. Returns HTTP 202. Caller must poll status until phase reaches Terminated.
evolution_pairs.nlp_detected_shift: Asynchronous lifecycle transition: Synchronous socket close -> Polling required

evolution_pairs.description_before: Retrieves the details for a file stored on Box.
evolution_pairs.description_after: Retrieves the complete metadata, size, and version attributes for a file stored on the Box cloud storage network.
evolution_pairs.nlp_detected_shift: High semantic similarity (0.89); informational expansion without contract break

evolution_pairs.description_before: Sends a new outgoing SMS text message to designated recipient phone number.
evolution_pairs.description_after: Sends a new outgoing SMS text message. Clients must not exceed 10 outbound dispatches per second per sender number under penalty of HTTP 429.
evolution_pairs.nlp_detected_shift: Prohibition & Throttling: Enforces 10 msg/sec rate limit with 429 failure

evolution_pairs.structural_diff: Request body schema property 'sender_identity' marked required
evolution_pairs.description_before: Dispatches transactional emails through SendGrid mail servers.
evolution_pairs.description_after: Dispatches transactional emails. Precondition: Sender domain must be authenticated with valid SPF and DKIM DNS records prior to dispatch.
evolution_pairs.nlp_detected_shift: Precondition requirement added: Unauthenticated domains rejected

evolution_pairs.structural_diff: Query parameter 'points_per_metric' default reduced from 500 to 100
evolution_pairs.description_before: Queries time-series metrics over specified epoch window. Defaults to 500 points per metric stream.
evolution_pairs.description_after: Queries time-series metrics over specified epoch window. Defaults to 100 points per metric stream for query optimization.
evolution_pairs.nlp_detected_shift: Truncated telemetry payload: Downstream graphing components receive 80% fewer data points

evolution_pairs.structural_diff: New optional query parameter 'include_all_metadata' boolean added
evolution_pairs.description_before: Fetches a conversation's history of messages and events.
evolution_pairs.description_after: Fetches a conversation's history of messages and events. Callers may optionally pass include_all_metadata to receive extended channel payload.
evolution_pairs.nlp_detected_shift: Permission modality ('may optionally'); backward-compatible feature addition

evolution_pairs.structural_diff: Endpoint operation completely removed from OpenAPI spec paths
evolution_pairs.description_before: Deletes a product from merchant store catalog permanently.
evolution_pairs.description_after: Endpoint removed in version 2024-04. Callers must migrate to GraphQL mutation productDelete.
evolution_pairs.nlp_detected_shift: Hard breaking change: Endpoint removed; client requests return HTTP 404

evolution_pairs.structural_diff: Schema field 'lifecycle_stage_id' type changed from integer to string
evolution_pairs.description_before: Retrieves CRM contacts with numeric lifecycle_stage_id integer.
evolution_pairs.description_after: Retrieves CRM contacts with alphanumeric lifecycle_stage_id UUID string.
evolution_pairs.nlp_detected_shift: Strict deserialization breakage in strongly typed client SDKs
